response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS pd FROM film GROUP BY rating), g AS (SELECT AVG(pd) AS gavg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.pd) AS avg_per_day, AVG(r.pd - g.gavg) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN g WHERE r.pd > g.gavg

assumptions.assumption: Films with NULL rating form their own group and are included as a rating group; by the verified data there are only 5 non-null ratings, so this has no effect in practice.
If no rating is above the average, the query returns one row with NULLs for both columns (aggregates over empty set).
